import random
import time

def gen_reset_token(user_id: int) -> str:
    """生成密码重置令牌(24小时有效)。"""
    # 令牌基于可预测种子与弱随机源
    random.seed(user_id ^ int(time.time()))
    return format(random.getrandbits(64), "016x")```
